about_the_game:
Overview

Your voice is your weapon.

Wordcaster is a voice-driven RPG adventure where you step into the robes of a wizard, casting spells by speaking words aloud. Real-time speech recognition listens to your voice and unleashes magic against enemies.

Gameplay

In Wordcaster, every spell comes from your voice. Choose from a variety of spellbooks, each with its own set of words and power multipliers. Face waves of enemies across multiple worlds, take down challenging bosses, and collect coins to upgrade your wizard.

Progression is built around classic RPG elements:

  • Spellbooks with unique vocabularies and damage multipliers

  • Levels & XP to grow stronger and unlock new abilities

  • Coins & Shops to purchase upgrades and customize your wizard

Whether you’re mastering basic words or commanding advanced spellbooks, every victory comes from how clearly and quickly you can cast your spells.

DLC

This DLC grants 100 Gems — a premium in-game currency, used to recharge your energy, buy EXP boosts, and unlock unique spellbooks.
